name: R017-ai-flash-own-accuracy-cut
why: Challenge 7. The opponent leads with Shuckle 528 (Sandstorm, Dig, Flash, Double Team; base speed 5). The player's Fearow 375 (Keen Eye, so Shuckle's Flash cannot cut its accuracy, and a Flying type that Dig cannot touch) uses Mud-Slap every turn: each hit lowers Shuckle's accuracy one stage. After two hits Shuckle's accuracy stage is 4, and every later turn AI_CV_AccuracyDown3 takes the second roll for Flash (battle_ai_scripts.s:1205-1207). Shuckle's Double Team can make some Mud-Slaps miss, so the script tries eight times.
